verdict.rationale: No evidence anywhere in the pack mentions IdP integrations (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), fleet enrollment/management tools, or policy enforcement for hardware-key authentication; evidence only covers WebAuthn/FIDO2 protocol support, firmware building, and hardware details. This is a plausible axis for a security key vendor (many competitors offer admin/fleet consoles), but SoloKeys shows nothing to support it.
